#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations
import fcntl
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
lock=(root/'results/metal-training.lock').open('a+')
print('waiting for shared Metal lock',flush=True)
fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(),fcntl.LOCK_EX)
print('Metal lock acquired',flush=True)
compiler=['/usr/bin/clang++','-x','objective-c++','-std=c++17','-O2','-fobjc-arc','-DSOURCE_DIR="'+str(root)+'"','-DFIXED_PPO_ACTOR_OBS_DIM=184',str(out/'mirror_reset_probe.mm'),'-framework','Foundation','-framework','Metal','-framework','Accelerate','-o',str(out/'mirror_reset_probe')]
with (out/'mirror-reset-probe.log').open('w') as log:
    subprocess.run(compiler,cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    subprocess.run([str(out/'mirror_reset_probe')],cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
print((out/'mirror-reset-probe.log').read_text(),end='',flush=True)
fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(),fcntl.LOCK_UN)
